noaa-etopo1.dataset: ETOPO1 1 Arc-Minute Global Relief Model, ice surface, grid-registered
noaa-etopo1.retrieval: NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP griddap etopo180, stride 10 (0.1667 deg)

natural-earth.dataset: Natural Earth vector data (land 1:50m, lakes 1:10m, rivers 1:10m + North America supplement)
natural-earth.citation: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com.
natural-earth.note: Not a federal dataset. Used only as a cartographic basemap; replace with USGS NHD/3DHP/WBD in a later milestone.

usgs-principal-aquifers.citation: U.S. Geological Survey, 2003, Principal Aquifers of the 48 Conterminous United States, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands: U.S. Geological Survey data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/P9Y2HOUJ.
usgs-principal-aquifers.note: 1:2,500,000 source; simplified at 0.02 deg for national display. Generated by scripts/build-aquifers.mjs.
